studies.label: Prospective mixed-methods validation of EuroQol instruments in Chinese paediatric patients and caregivers
studies.family_rationale: The principal planned contribution is an evaluation of validity, reliability, responsiveness, feasibility, agreement and score performance for EuroQol instruments. The protocol states that baseline collection started on 1 April 2024 and was due to continue until March 2026; it reports no study results.
